services.name: request-service

apis.description: Curated feed scored on 7 signals. Sprint 85/86 ADR-066: view=home returns the UnifiedFeedItem union ({ items }) of decisions+requests; view=community returns the community-scoped union of requests+activity+story texture (no decisions), requires community_id (400) + caller membership (403), assembled from request-service's own DB reads (no feed-service call), texture best-effort. Action altitude bands: decisions>=2000 > requests 1000-1100 > activity 500 > story 100. Each request item carries payload_type (ADR-067, from category via categoryToPayloadType). view absent keeps the legacy request-array shape. Prior-interaction signal reads the decayed trust_edges_live.current_weight. Sprint 88: minScore defaults to 30, explicit minScore=0 is valid for show-more/all-open expansion, and request impressions are logged for legacy and union request items.

Sprint 89 / ADR-068: the community's weekly help-loop pulse for the warm community Home hero (helpedThisWeek, openAsks, timeSensitive, recentJoins, recentHelpers, windowDays:7). Reuses the exact S86 texture aggregation (shared fetchCommunityPulse helper that also builds the in-feed activity card, so the two never diverge) + one new timeSensitive count. openAsks/timeSensitive count only status=open AND expired=FALSE. Members-only: gated on the JWT communities claim (not communityMemberships) -> 403 for non-members; unknown community -> 404. Read-only, no schema change.

Sprint 90 / ADR-069: resolved retention windows (completed/expired/message, community->global->fallback via requests.retention_config) + the member's own held vs forgotten request counts. Backs the /about/memory transparency page. Read-only, no PII. Membership-gated on the JWT communities claim when ?communityId= is supplied (non-member -> 403). MUST be registered before /requests/:id (route-order).

Browse active providers (public, optional ?service_type). When called WITH a token, each provider is annotated with shared_communities — the communities the provider and viewer both belong to (ADR-073, Sprint 93); unauthenticated responses are unchanged

Remove active boost from a request (admin only)
Admin proposes a specific community member as a helper (creates proposed match with admin_proposed=TRUE on requests.matches)
Toggle request urgency between urgent and medium (admin only)
List provider offers on a request (requester only)

Decline a pending provider offer
Submit a provider offer on an open help request
List offers submitted by the authenticated provider
Withdraw a pending provider offer

services.name: cleanup-service

apis.description: Sprint 90 / ADR-069: admin-triggered run of the memory retention job (memoryRetentionJob.forgetExchangeContent). Anonymizes aged completed-request free-text + cascade-forgets messages, hard-deletes expired/unmatched requests, backstops old messages. Returns per-branch counts. Also runs daily at 3:30 AM via cron.

services.notes: CANDIDATE FOR REPLACEMENT: Could be replaced with pg_cron scheduled jobs. Scheduled jobs: dibs expiry (5m), match reminders (15m), mark-expired (hourly), hard-delete (2am), reputation decay (3am), memoryRetentionJob (3:30am, Sprint 90/ADR-069 — anonymizes completed-exchange free-text to '[forgotten]' sentinels + cascade-forgets messages, hard-deletes expired/unmatched requests; karma_records left untouched; per-community retention windows via request_communities → retention_config), trust edge sweep (4:30am), activity log cleanup (weekly), decay report (weekly). Sprint 90 RETIRED requestTtlSweepJob (it hard-deleted completed+rated exchanges at 30d, destroying aggregates before the anonymize window — superseded by memoryRetentionJob). Governed by requests.retention_config.

services.notes: Trust-first design foundation. Sprint 27: match_completed → social_graph.connections. Sprint 65: match_completed → social_graph.trust_edges. Sprint 67: ego-network rewrite — GET /trust/graph (aggregate) + GET /trust/graph/:communityId (community ego-network). Sprint 68: intrinsic Ebbinghaus decay via trust_edges_live view + decay config endpoints. Sprint 90: visible decay (ADR-070) — graph edges carry decayTier; new /trust/me/memory + /trust/relationships/fading endpoints; classifyDecayTier lives in @karmyq/shared.
